root_cause: VCS W-2024.09 clears ucliCore::_vars_list on restore. A subsequent save then serializes internal Tcl globals including readonly synopsys_root as user variables. Top-level restore alone is insufficient.
workaround: Refresh the UCLI initial-global-name list immediately after restore and before loading external replay control. No vendor file, HDL state or snapshot data is edited. Replay control is external; preexisting user Tcl globals are intentionally not relied on.
nonclaims: Full K numerical result pending final DDR checks
